failure_class: GPU out of memory while creating an independent PairedDualReceiver context; ChannelEqualizer initialization
post_failure_cleanup: Three experiment worker PIDs remained after controller crash and were terminated explicitly; the MPS control/server PIDs were then terminated after quit hung. The job-local GPU lock was removed. No timed radio JSON exists.
interpretation: Eight-cell time arithmetic was insufficient: the current one-receiver-per-cell implementation could not initialize eight physical cell contexts on this GPU. This is a pretraffic feasibility failure, not a deadline or bound sample and not a fundamental impossibility after memory redesign.
